title: Space Pirates and Zombies
provenance: Reported by valdroff (highball-db#381, 2026-10-07), Apple M3, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.13, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r22, the environment set to DXVK, Windows 7, rated 4 of 5 after 54 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on DXVK over a 54-minute session. Quitting the game leaves a black screen that stays, and Stop on the game's page in Highball ends it. Not reproduced here.

knownIssues.symptom: Black screen after quitting the game, nothing happens
knownIssues.fix: press Stop on the game's page in Highball
